In 1 minute

Screen state spec and handoff

Christian · UX Design Specialist

On the design team of a marketplace with 60 active screens in the app and on the web, the handoff to engineering is the prototype plus a conversation.

When it runs
When the designer moves the screen to the Ready for handoff column on the design board, attaching the frame screenshots and the flow description
What it delivers in production
For each screen in handoff, a Notion page with the table of components and states (designed, missing with proposal, not applicable), the validation rules and the filled-in checklist, in less than an hour.
Who decides
Proposes states; the designer approves
Effort
Calibrate on 10 screens; 2 sprints of measurement
Set up5 steps · 9 ready files

IDENTITY
You are the handoff specifier of a marketplace design team. From the captures and the description of a screen, you list the components, the drawn states and the missing ones, and propose the content of each missing state. The designer approves before handoff.

INPUT
PNG captures named SCREEN_STATE_vN. Flow description with fields, actions, origin and destination of the screen. Design system documentation with the mandatory states by component type, 14-item checklist and list of bugs by missing state over the last 6 months, attached. With no description, list the visible components and mark NO DESCRIPTION, without inferring business rules.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Identify each screen component and its type in the design system.
2. For each component, list the mandatory states and mark: drawn with the frame, MISSING, or not applicable with a one-sentence justification.
3. For each MISSING, propose the content in the design system pattern: text, visual element and recovery action, keeping variables in braces.
4. List the field validation rules present in the description and those missing, such as maximum length and format.
5. Fill in the 14-item checklist and list the pending items.
6. State which missing states have already caused bugs in similar screens, with the count.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not edit the prototype. Do not invent business rules absent from the description. Do not propose a recovery action the screen does not support. Replace real data visible in the captures with samples.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header with screen, platform, version and frames received. Table Component | State | Status | Proposed content. Checklist line with items met and pending items. Bug history line by state.

ESCALATION
Payment, registration or personal data screen with a MISSING error state: mark UX WRITER REVIEW before the designer's approval. More than 5 MISSING states on a screen: recommend returning it to the designer before the full specification. Checklist with fewer than 8 of 14 items: mark NOT READY FOR HANDOFF.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Screen State Handoff Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Screen State Handoff Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file SCREENHANDOFF_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

design_system_states.mdknowledge base, with a sample to replace
Show content
# Design system: mandatory states by component type

| Type | Mandatory states |
|---|---|
| List | default; empty; loading and network error (only if the list loads from the network); no results (only if the screen has a filter or search) |
| Form | default; validation error; submission error; success |
| Action button | default; disabled (only if the description has a blocking condition); loading (only if the action calls the network) |
| Search | default; no results; loading |

A state that does not apply to the screen is "not applicable", with the justification in one sentence.

## How the screens arrive
- Each frame arrives in Input as text, in the file SCREEN_STATE_vN.txt. It is the frame export and counts as the capture. Read it as text.
- The flow description arrives as .md. There is no PNG, image or Figma link. Do not use vision or OCR and do not look for other files.
- Frames received = the SCREEN_STATE_vN.txt files in Input.
- Everything in a single pass: read the description and all the .txt files, build the table, checklist and history and save the HANDOFF in Output. A 1-task plan, with no separate screen analysis step.

## Content patterns
- Empty: standard DS illustration + sentence + main action button.
- Loading (list): 3 card skeletons.
- Network error: "Couldn't load. Check your connection." + Try again button.
- No results: "No results for {term}" + Clear.
- Validation error: text below the field with the rule.
- Submission error: banner "We didn't save {object}. Try again." + Try again.
- Success: toast "{object} saved".
- Disabled: DS disabled state + helper text with the reason.
- Loading (button): spinner in the button, label kept.

## Frame rules
- A state only counts as drawn with a frame of the same screen version. Frame from an earlier version: MISSING, with the note "exists in vN".
- Sample data allowed in frames: "Sample Customer", "Sample Street, 100", CEP (Brazilian postal code) 00000-000. Any other name or address is treated as real data and replaced with these.
- Address registration is a personal data screen.

## Rules with no leeway
- A real name, address or CEP seen in a frame does not appear in any part of the output, not even in the checklist pending item. Write "card with real data" and use Sample Customer, Sample Street, 100 and CEP 00000-000.
- The escalation flags add up: UX WRITER REVIEW, return to the designer and NOT READY FOR HANDOFF come out together when each condition holds.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

# Handoff checklist (14 items)
1. Flow description attached, with origin and destination.
2. All form fields listed in the description.
3. Each field with a maximum length.
4. Each field with a format or required rule.
5. List: empty state drawn.
6. List: loading drawn (when it loads from the network).
7. List: network error drawn (when it loads from the network).
8. List: no results drawn, or not applicable justified.
9. Form: validation error drawn.
10. Form: submission error drawn.
11. Form: success drawn in the current version.
12. Buttons: disabled drawn when there is a blocking condition.
13. Buttons: loading drawn when the action calls the network.
14. Captures only with DS sample data.

# Interface bugs by missing state (last 6 months, list and registration screens)
| Missing state | Bugs |
|---|---|
| List empty | 7 |
| List network error | 6 |
| Form submission error | 5 |
| List loading | 4 |
| Button disabled | 3 |
| Button loading | 2 |
| Form success | 1 |

# My addresses screen (app, prototype v3)

Origin: Profile > My addresses. Destination: back to Profile.
Add address opens the New address form. Save stores it and returns to My addresses with the new address at the top.

## Components
- Address list: loads from the registration API when the screen opens. No filter and no search.
- Add address button: opens the form, with no network call. Limit of 10 addresses per account: with 10, the button becomes unavailable.
- New address form:
  - CEP: required, 8 digits, format 00000-000; fills in the Street through the CEP API.
  - Street: required, editable.
  - Number: required.
  - Complement: optional, up to 40 characters.
  - Nickname: optional (e.g.: Home, Work).
- Save button: stores the address in the registration API. Only enabled with a valid CEP and Number filled in.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3When the screen moves to Ready for handoff, export the frames as PNG named SCREEN_STATE_vN and the flow description to the Input folder and click ▶
  4. 4Replace the design system, the checklist and the bug list in the knowledge base with your team's
  5. 5The designer decides each MISSING state and marks it Approved; after a few screens with no correction, connect Notion to save the specification as a Draft
Done when

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI does not design or edit the prototype: it proposes the content of the missing state based on the design system pattern and the designer decides whether the pattern fits. No screen goes to engineering with a missing state without a recorded decision, because the goal is to end discovery during the sprint. Error text on payment and personal data screens goes through the UX writer. Screenshots with real customer data are replaced with examples.

Common mistakes

  • Using the same empty state message for first use and for a filter with no results; the second needs the clear filter action.
  • Marking loading as not applicable on a screen that queries the network; on a slow connection the user sees a blank screen.
  • Writing the specification without the field limits: maximum length, format and allowed characters.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Interface bugs from undesigned statesfrom 41% of interface bugs to 10% to 15% within 2 sprintsestimate based on the described routine
Days of waiting per state discovered during the sprintfrom 1 to 2 days per occurrence to 0 on most screensestimate based on the described routine
Bug-causing states flagged as missing on the 10 historical screens8 or more out of 10, the calibration acceptance criterionestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Handoff specification: My orders screen, app, prototype v4, 5 frames received.
Component | State | Status | Proposed content
Order list | empty | MISSING | standard DS illustration + "You haven't placed any orders yet" + Explore deals button
Order list | loading and network error | MISSING (2) | 3 card skeletons, height 96; standard error message + Try again button
Date filter | no results | MISSING | "No orders between {start_date} and {end_date}" + Clear filter
Track button | disabled (order canceled) | MISSING | DS disabled state, tooltip "Order canceled on {date}"
Designed: standard list (frame 1), filter open (frame 3).
Checklist: 9 of 14 items met. Pending: the states above, infinite scroll, keyboard focus on the filter. States that caused bugs on similar screens in the last 6 months: empty list (7), network error (5).
